identifier.reasoning: This column names the biological metrics or traits being measured (e.g., Species richness).

Site age χ².reasoning: This column contains the calculated chi-squared statistical test results.

Site age P.reasoning: This column contains the associated p-values for the site age statistical test.

Burn status χ².reasoning: This column contains the calculated chi-squared statistical test results for burn status.

Burn status P.reasoning: This column contains the associated p-values for the burn status statistical test.

Year χ².reasoning: This column contains the calculated chi-squared statistical test results for the year.

Year P.reasoning: This column contains the associated p-values for the year statistical test.
